title: Dynamics of the globular cluster system associated with M49 (NGC 4472): cluster orbital properties and the distribution of dark matter

evidence.locator: table2: 345 radial-velocity rows of confirmed and candidate M49 globular clusters with J2000 positions from Geisler et al. (1996); the 263 distinct objects of class GC are used. 33 of them lie within 0.8 arcsec of a Jordán et al. (2009) cluster (median 0.7 arcsec) and are drawn from that catalogue; the next nearest pair is 2.6 arcsec apart.
